summary.text: Leila Staton is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 54 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Joshua Meggers.
She works as a legal assistant and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Leila Staton graduated from Dike-New Hartford High School, and her career experience includes working as a legal assistant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a sixth-generation Iowan and the daughter of a single mother who has advocated at the Capitol, including in subcommittee hearings.
The survey said she co-founded a local advocacy organization in 2024 that works on public schools, healthcare, housing and civil rights.

Staton's survey answers listed three priorities: public oversight of the state's education savings account (school voucher) program, expanded rural healthcare with a focus on women's healthcare, and protecting family farms.
